Working with film-crew → seedance-25-director.

This session couldn't run the start/end routine. The folder isn't a git repo, there was no NOTES.md, and I had no shell, so I couldn't pull, push or run the package validator. I checked the package by hand instead. I created `NOTES.md` with today's entry and saved the crew plan to `film-crew/kids-books-promo-15s/plan.md`. Both still need to be committed and pushed.

**Assumptions:**
- The footage is live-action and realistic.
- Seedance makes the picture only. The voice-over, music and logo go on in the edit, so Seedance never sees or changes the recorded Armenian voice.
- There's no character reference, and one call keeps the girl the same across shots 1–2.

**Plan, set to the voice-over:**

| Shot | Time | Voice-over | What we see | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.0–4.2 | "Every child has a question…" | A 7-year-old girl at a cold blue window draws a "?" in the fog on the glass. It starts to fade. | The question nobody answered |
| 2 | 4.2–9.2 | "We write the books… in Armenian" | Warm lamp, bed, open book with the letter Ա. Slow push-in, she turns a page, realises, smiles. | The answer, cold → warm |
| 3 | 9.2–12.2 | "Maghakian Scripts…" | From above: three books, small to thick. A toddler's, a child's and a teenager's hands lift them together. | Ages 0–16 |
| 4 | 12.2–15.0 | "…ages zero to sixteen" + 1 s tail | The three books stand upright with the red ribbon. The camera stops at 14.0 and holds. Black space on top for the logo. | End card |

The cuts at 4.2 and 9.2 sit inside the gaps in the voice-over (4.0–4.5 and 9.0–9.5), so no word is cut. The ribbon bookmark is the only red object in the film, as the brand's one red accent.

**Risks:**
- **Armenian letter:** Armenian isn't on Seedance's supported-language list, so the letter Ա may come out garbled. If it does, change that line to "decorative letters, soft and unreadable" and add Ա as an overlay in the edit.
- **Girl changes between shots:** if she looks different in shots 1 and 2, make one still of her with banana-pro, upload it as @Image 1, and re-run.
- **Moderation:** realistic children can sometimes trigger a block. The prompt keeps it simple and family-friendly.

## FINAL

**Settings (Dreamina, Seedance 2.5):**
- **Mode:** Omni Reference, with no uploads (text only).
- **Duration, ratio, resolution:** 15 s · 9:16 · 1080p if offered, otherwise 720p.
- **Seeds:** generate 2–3 and keep the best.
- **In the edit:**
  - Lay the Armenian voice-over at 0.0 s.
  - Put a soft piano bed under it at about −18 dB.
  - Put the logo on from 9.5 s to 15.0 s in the empty top of the frame, with the line «Գրքեր 0–16 տարեկանների համար».
  - Trim the ribbon's red to #D90429.

```text
15-second vertical 9:16 promo, 4 shots, 3 hard cuts, 24 fps, live-action, realistic, quiet and intimate.

CUT POLICY: hard cuts only at 4.2s, 9.2s and 12.2s; no other cuts, no transitions, no dissolves.

SOUND POLICY: pure video, no dialogue, no voice-over, no background music, no subtitles. Only these sounds exist: 1) a fingertip squeaking softly on cold glass (0-4.2s); 2) one paper page turning (4.2-9.2s); 3) soft thuds of books lifted from a wooden table (9.2-12.2s); 4) quiet room tone (12.2-15s).

CHARACTER (the same girl in shots 1 and 2, described the same way every time): a 7-year-old Armenian girl, dark brown hair in two loose braids, dark eyes, light olive skin with natural texture, wearing an oversized cream-white knit sweater. Calm and curious, no posing, never looks into the lens.

PALETTE: black, graphite grey, warm white. Exactly one red accent in the whole film: a deep crimson satin ribbon bookmark. No other red objects.

SHOTS
[0-4.2s] Shot 1, close-up profile of the girl at a dark bedroom window at blue hour. The glass is already fogged by her breath. She draws a large question mark in the fog with her index finger, lowers her hand and keeps looking out. The question mark slowly begins to fade. Cool blue window light from frame-right on her face; the room behind her is dark. 50mm lens, camera almost still with slight natural handheld breathing. Last frame: her profile facing frame-right, the question mark half-faded on the glass beside her face.

[4.2-9.2s] Shot 2, the same girl sitting in bed under a graphite-grey duvet, a large open picture book on her knees. A warm bedside lamp on frame-left is the only light. Left page: a soft watercolour illustration of a night sky. Right page: one large decorative Armenian capital letter "Ա" above lines of small text, soft and unreadable. The crimson ribbon bookmark lies across the page. The camera starts on a medium shot and pushes in slowly and steadily to a close-up of her face above the book. At 6s she turns one page; at 7.5s her eyebrows lift, her lips part, then a small smile. Last frame: close-up, warm lamp light on her face, eyes down on the page, smiling.

[9.2-12.2s] Shot 3, overhead top-down view of a dark graphite wooden table. Three closed books in a row, left to right: a small square board book, a medium picture book with the crimson ribbon bookmark, a thick novel. Plain matte covers with no readable text. Three hands enter from the bottom of the frame and rest on the books at the same moment: a toddler's small hand, a 7-year-old's hand in a cream knit sleeve, a teenager's hand. Then they lift the books together out of frame. Static camera. The top third of the frame is empty dark graphite. Last frame: the empty table.

[12.2-15s] Shot 4, front view at eye level: the same three books standing upright, closed, side by side on the graphite table against a black background, the crimson ribbon bookmark hanging from the middle book. One soft warm top light. A very slow push-in that stops at 14s, then holds perfectly still until 15s. The upper 40% of the frame is clean, empty black space. Last frame: the three books in the lower half of the frame, still.

CAMERA: grounded, physical and slow; no orbit, no whip pans, no zoom jumps, no fast moves.

PERFORMANCE: one physical channel per shot: the finger on the glass, then the eyes and mouth, then the hands. Small, real gestures; no exaggerated surprise, no waving, no looking into the lens.

LIGHTING: shot 1 is cool blue window light, and the darkest values in the room behind her keep shadow detail. Shots 2-4 are warm tungsten lamp light, with the brightest value on the face or the book pages and soft contact shadows under the books. Cold to warm is the arc of the film.

LOOK: natural skin texture, fine film grain, soft contrast, muted palette; no teal-and-orange, no glossy commercial look, no cartoon look.

BANS: no on-screen text except the single letter Ա on the page, no logos, no subtitles, no extra people, no adult faces, no second red object, no readable book titles.
```
